summary:
Meeting #39 — TeamHQ Improvement Priorities + RT-38c Status

Team held standup #39. Each member pitched one concrete TeamHQ improvement.

**Decided (ranked):**
1. Pipeline status dashboard on TeamHQ homepage — reads existing pipeline-log data, no new backend. First slice of autonomy dashboard.
2. GET /api/health endpoint — 30-minute quick win. Jonah builds today.
3. Keyboard shortcuts for meetings/projects — after RT-38c ships.
4. Design token audit — Robert as lightweight iteration.

**RT-38c:** Alice actively building. Modal + fuzzy search working. On track for Thursday.

**Next:** Scoping pipeline dashboard now (lightweight iteration). Jonah starts health endpoint. Both parallel with Forge.
